diagnosis_scope: training and validation only; no revised test forecasts or outcomes inspected
old_model_selection: 28-day rolling mean selected by validation MAE; not an estimator fault
changed_features: 10 history/calendar inputs + 3 optional news aggregates + at most min(50,n_train//3) unigrams
selection_pool_note: compact Poisson models, as requested; averages are separate benchmarks
provenance_note: The original historical test was already scored in v1; the revised selection excludes it, but it is a reused holdout.
same_frozen_origin_repeated_cli: Default forecast origin is derived from the frozen acquisition cutoff; repeated runs with unchanged data intentionally reproduce the same forecast. Refresh the vintage or choose a different eligible noon origin for another forecast day.
